claims: Jessie Buckley won the Oscar for Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards.
The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
Jessie Buckley won the Best Actress Oscar for her role as Agnes in the film Hamnet.
Jessie Buckley's Best Actress Oscar win marked her first Academy Award win.
Jessie Buckley received a previous Academy Award nomination in 2022.
Jessie Buckley (Hamnet) was the 2026 Best Actress winner.
Rose Byrne (If I Had Legs I'd Kick You) was a 2026 Best Actress nominee.
Kate Hudson (Song Sung Blue) was a 2026 Best Actress nominee.
Renate Reinsve (Sentimental Value) was a 2026 Best Actress nominee.
Emma Stone (Bugonia) was a 2026 Best Actress nominee.
Jessie Buckley is the first Irish woman to win the Best Actress Oscar.
In her acceptance speech, Jessie Buckley dedicated the award to the "beautiful chaos of a mother's heart".
In her acceptance speech, Jessie Buckley thanked her family.
Hamnet is an adaptation of Maggie O'Farrell's novel.
The 98th Academy Awards honored films released in 2025.
